jobAds.title: Brand Manager - Next Generation Products
jobAds.description:
Brand Manager – Next Generation Products

  • Location: Gentofte, Copenhagen, Denmark or United Kingdom
  • Working hours: Full-time
  • Work model: Hybrid / Remote
  • Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract, 12 months
  • Travel: Approximately 20% across key markets and external partners

Are you passionate about building brands, launching innovative products, and driving growth in dynamic international markets? Do you want to play a key role in shaping the future of Next Generation Products? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Brand Manager – Next Generation Products you will be part of our Next Generation Products Marketing team and play an important role in driving the global brand and portfolio strategy for our nicotine pouch category. You will work closely with commercial teams, R&D, Regulatory Affairs and Supply Chain to translate consumer insights into successful innovations and business growth, reporting to the Global Brand Director – Next Generation Products. This is a great opportunity to influence a rapidly evolving category and help shape STG's future growth agenda in an international organization.

What your day will look like

In this role, you will typically focus on:

  • Drive the development and launch of new nicotine pouch products, including flavours, formats, strengths and packaging innovations.
  • Manage and optimize the global product portfolio, including lifecycle management, assortment decisions and portfolio performance.
  • Contribute to global brand strategy, positioning and innovation pipelines to ensure consistent and compelling brand propositions.
  • Partner with regional and local teams to improve category performance, identify growth opportunities and support commercial execution.
  • Analyze consumer insights, market trends and competitive developments to inform business and innovation decisions.
  • Collaborate across functions to deliver strategic projects and bring innovations to market.

What you'll bring

  • 4–7 years of experience in Brand Management, Marketing, Product Management or a related commercial role.
  • A strong understanding of brand strategy, portfolio management, product development and innovation processes.
  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across different markets and functions.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate consumer and market insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field.
  • It is an advantage if you have experience from FMCG, consumer goods or a similar fast-paced industry, or a Master's degree.

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

Our recruitment process

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:

  • Recruiter screen
  • Interview with the hiring team
  • Assessment, case study, or work sample, if relevant
  • Final interview with leadership or key stakeholders

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

jobAds.title: Product Engineer, Hørsholm
jobAds.description:
You will play a key role in making new products ready for production, contributing to the manufacture and testing of prototypes, and ensuring that experience from production, suppliers and customers is translated into specific product improvements.

As part of the development team, you will work closely with developers, technicians, production teams, PCB suppliers and product specialists to ensure products can be produced, tested, documented and supported efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include prototype assembly and testing, preparing PCB test procedures, and maintaining PCB, design and production documentation to support product release and continuous improvement. In collaboration with PCB suppliers and product specialists, you will also contribute to design changes, ECO/ECM processes and component end-of-life (EOL) management.

About the role and key responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities:

  • Ensure the effective transfer of products from development to production, including NPI, documentation and release to production

  • Contribute to the manufacture, assembly and testing of prototypes in close collaboration with development, production and suppliers

  • Plan and coordinate testing, validation and verification activities, and prepare and maintain test procedures for printed circuit boards, products and subsystems

  • Maintain PCB documentation, design documentation, bills of materials, product data and production processes in connection with development, handover and production maturation

  • Support production with technical assistance, troubleshooting, root cause analyses and continuous improvements

  • Lead and contribute to ECO and ECM processes, and manage design changes and component end-of-life (EOL) in collaboration with PCB suppliers and product specialists

  • Work closely with subcontractors and PCB suppliers to support prototype development, production, testing, documentation and product improvements

  • Contribute to compliance, traceability and regulatory requirements while developing and maintaining high-quality technical documentation, including manuals, instructions and technical training materials

Your profile

We expect that you:

  • Hold an engineering degree or an equivalent technical qualification

  • Have experience in product development, production engineering, Product Engineering or NPI processes

  • Have hands-on experience with prototypes, testing, validation and technical troubleshooting

  • Have experience with electronics. Experience with printed circuit boards, mechanics or mechatronics is considered an advantage

  • Thrive at the intersection of hardware, software, production and supplier collaboration, working closely with developers, production teams, product specialists, service functions and external suppliers

  • Work systematically with documentation, quality, test procedures and process improvements

  • Communicate effectively in both Danish and English.

**Additional information
**We offer:

  • A central role in a strong professional environment with a high level of responsibility

  • Flexibility, development opportunities, and access to highly specialized expertise

  • A workplace focused on quality, innovation, and future-proof solutions

  • An informal and collaborative culture that values initiative and professional curiosity

At Force Technology, you work alongside specialists who are deeply committed to their fields and proud of the value their expertise creates. Many choose to build their careers here because they enjoy exploring their field in depth and pushing the boundaries of their expertise.

The opportunity to specialise does not mean doing the same thing every day. Customer challenges, new technologies and cross-disciplinary collaboration create opportunities for continuous learning.

Despite the high level of expertise, the culture is informal and approachable. Colleagues take an interest in each other, share their knowledge generously and are always willing to help.

Does this sound like something for you?

If you think this job is for you, send us your application today. We process applications on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for interview along the way. Please note that we only accept electronic applications via our recruitment system.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Troels Balmer Christensen on trch@forcetechnology.com.

We look forward to receiving your application, CV and other relevant attachments.

At Force Technology, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, and we are actively looking for qualified people candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability or age.

_Force Technology
_

At Force Technology, we help businesses and society navigate technological opportunities and challenges safely.

As one of Denmark's largest GTS institutes, we play a unique role in strengthening innovation, competitiveness and technological resilience. As an independent expert authority and technology advisor, we help ensure that technology creates value for people, businesses and society.

When you join us, you become part of an expert environment with more than 1,000 specialists across 18 offices in 4 countries working together to turn knowledge into sustainable solutions.

jobAds.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobAds.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English

Please note:
You must be an EU/EEA citizen. Applicants who do not meet this requirement should not apply.

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.
